thread:
Alex: Heads-up — customer asks for tenant-scoped BYOK (HSM-backed) + audit-level key access logs. Want to discuss scope and launch criteria for Q1 pilot.

Maria: Which customer and which deployment mode? hosted or Dedicated/Private? :thinking_face:

Alex: Large fintech pilot, wants Hosted + Dedicated initially. Key concerns: key custody, exportability for legal hold, and audit trail of key ops.

Sanjay: High level tradeoffs: we can support envelope encryption with customer KMS (recommended) or full key import into our vault (harder for compliance). Envelope gives lower risk but increases latency on key unwrap calls.

Kevin: Can we quantify latency? envelope unwrap per request will add ~5–10ms on avg if cached, or ~50–100ms cold. Need benchmarks.

Elise: Also need to map to SOC2 controls — who signs access logs, retention policy, immutable logs for key access. Compliance wants 7 years for some customers.

compliance-bot: New compliance ticket created: CUST-836-BYOK. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUST-836

Maria: Proposed MVP scope: 1) BYOK via customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure KeyVault) with envelope encryption, 2) per-tenant audit events for key unwrap/wrap exported to customer-controlled audit exports, 3) docs + config UI for key aliases.

Sanjay: Add-on: support HSM-backed keys (Cloud HSM) requirement for customers with FIPS/HSM mandate — implement as part of Dedicated & Private first. Hosted can be phased.

Alex: Launch criteria suggestions: a) e2e pilot with one fintech customer on Dedicated, b) latency degradation <=10% for typical workloads, c) audit export proof (sample export for legal review), d) internal SOC2 mapping doc updated.

Kevin: Ops constraints: key rotation. How do we surface rollover? We can offer an automated rotation flow that re-wraps model artifacts and supports rollover with dual-key window for 24 hours. Need design doc for fallback.

Elise: For retention: customers asking 7 years for key access logs, but storage/costs are non-trivial. Proposal: normalize export format (NDJSON) and let customers push to their S3/GCS with lifecycle rules. We'll include recommended retention templates for legal hold (7y) and default 90d.

Sanjay: Minimal API example for export config: ```json
{"export_destination":"s3://cust-bucket/redwood/key-audit/","format":"ndjson","retention_days":2555}
```

Maria: Pricing/contract question: BYOK + audit export should be tiered as an enterprise add-on. We'll draft pricing playbook — sales to confirm willingness to pay.

Alex: Risks: 1) Hosted BYOK for HSM customers could be a blocker, 2) audit export integrity — need signed manifests, 3) legal hold complexity across multi-region exports.

Elise: Next steps / owners: @Sanjay write design PR for envelope + rotation (due Tue), @Kevin run perf microbenchmarks for unwrap patterns (due Fri), @Maria draft SOC2 control mapping + pricing ask (due next Wed), @Alex coordinate pilot kickoff with customer (sync with SE).

Kevin: Quick note — add canary rollout plan: start with Dedicated pool + feature flag, validate logs, then enable Hosted read-only BYOK for pilot.

Alex: Agreed. I'll set up a 30-min sync with the fintech pilot next Mon. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
